propositions: The ADR-promised byte-total backstop trigger does not exist in _gc_pass; the janitor checks only free disk space and entry mtime, never consulting the incrementally-maintained byte_total counter
materialize_tickets bypasses cache.acquire and never calls add_bytes, leaving its entries (totaling ~1.7 GiB of tickets on the review-bot host) unaccounted in the store's byte total
With both gaps present, the snapshot store has no functional size-based reclaim mechanism despite the ADR promising a byte-total-backstopped cap
The fix adds a max_bytes tunable (default off) that drives LRU eviction when the store exceeds its configured cap, mirroring the free-space watermark behavior
materialize_tickets now accounts its entries via add_bytes on the cache-hit-won path, aligning the incremental counter with the authoritative walk performed by startup_sweep
